parameters.name: KvList
parameters.description: The list of key-value pairs to add or update. The total size cannot exceed 2 MB (2 × 1000 × 1000 bytes).

sub_parameters.name: Expiration
sub_parameters.description: The expiration time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time cannot be earlier than the current time. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

sub_parameters.name: ExpirationTtl
sub_parameters.description: The relative expiration time in seconds. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The name of the key. The key can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/).
